  "pros": [
    "Contact management was straightforward and intuitive.",
    "Initial setup and lead tracking capabilities were effective.",
    "Interface was generally user-friendly for daily tasks."
  ],
  "cons": [
    "Exporting data for migration proved to be complex and time-consuming.",
    "Lacked advanced customization options for specific workflows.",
    "Pricing could become a concern as features are added."
  ],
  "overall_experience": "The Director found Freshsales to be a generally competent CRM, especially for basic lead and contact management, which was an improvement over their previous system. However, the critical task of exporting contacts for migration was more challenging than anticipated, leading to some frustration. While the ease of use for general functions was appreciated, the lack of seamless data portability and potential for increasing costs were noted drawbacks for this small IT services firm."
